purpose: Describe which runtime-facing entrypoints are part of the publishable CLI contract and which repo-maintenance tools remain outside the npm package surface.

public_runtime_entrypoints.profile_boundary: The CLI defaults diagnose to the runtime profile for packaged/user-facing health checks. The source repository can still run REDCAP_DIAGNOSE_PROFILE=source bash compass/tools/redcap-diagnose.sh for the full maintainer governance chain.

public_runtime_entrypoints.contract_boundary: Public diagnostic entrypoint for viewing or refreshing Prism provider availability. It exposes provider health, not Prism raw evidence or maintainer governance internals.

maintainer_release_entrypoints.contract_boundary: Maintainer release-readiness commands. They may be packaged during alpha readiness, but they are not normal end-user workflow and not stable public runtime API.

source_maintenance_entrypoints.contract_boundary: Source-maintainer convenience commands. They support RedCap development and governance, but public users should not need to understand them before using the runtime.

excluded_from_public_package: R0-R22 recovery registries and one-off reconstruction tooling
full LLM-wiki/RAG/GraphRAG research and stratification tooling
host-specific live-marker probes that are not part of the portable runtime contract
must_not_claim: This import map is not a full physical move of compass/tools or prism/tools.
This import map does not authorize npm publish.
This import map does not turn excluded maintainer tools into deleted or deprecated tools; they remain source-repo maintenance assets.
